_comment: The claim register (C-06). Each entry is a published sentence, the command that enforces it, and the document it lives in. tools/check-claims.mjs fails if a sentence disappears (the claim was rewritten or lost), if its owner is not a file in this repo, or if the owner runs in no CI lane. Counts are NOT stored here — stamp.mjs owns every number, and a register that carried one would be the hand-written count this file exists to prevent. CHANGELOG.md is deliberately not a claim-bearing document: it is a dated record of past states.

claims.sentence: State is never colour alone; every chart series carries a dash pattern as well as a hue.
claims.threshold: legend key must preview the series' own dash or solid paint

claims.sentence: text_contrast: "4.5:1"
claims.threshold: TEXT_MIN 4.5

claims.sentence: and every series clears 3:1 against every surface it can be
claims.threshold: the sentence beside the chart — the one a reader actually sees

claims.sentence: zero runtime dependencies, no build
claims.threshold: src/ imports nothing outside the repo; package.json declares no dependencies

claims.sentence: not the mechanism WCAG 2.2.2 asks for
claims.threshold: every infinite animation is pausable and a control ships on a page

claims.sentence: re-tints every primary surface
claims.threshold: a root --brand-hue re-point must move a freshly mounted .c-btn--primary

claims.sentence: The pattern is a def the host inlines
claims.threshold: every url(#id) in src/css resolves to a def inside src/, with a fallback on a paint

claims.sentence: and the gridline band is **derived** from `--chart-ticks` — one band per value
claims.threshold: re-pointing --chart-ticks must move the rendered band by 100/(ticks-1)

claims.sentence: <!-- ds:components-line -->
claims.threshold: the published component and token counts are computed from src/, never typed

claims.sentence: named image, not inside it: `role="img"` is a leaf role, so a description nested in
claims.threshold: the data alternative must not be a descendant of the named image

claims.sentence: they gap by different tokens, so an alias between them would silently restyle every use
claims.threshold: GAP_CONTRACT pins --space-stack/--space-sm and --space-2xs/--space-sm

claims.sentence: `.stack` and `.c-stack` are NOT the same rule
claims.threshold: the ratchet plus the gap contract; the ledger may only shrink

claims.sentence: A status message is announced from a live region that exists, empty, before anything is said
claims.threshold: the same live-host assertions as C-28-a, measured in the guide's loaded document

claims.sentence: While a snippet disclosure is open the rest of the page leaves the tab order, and closing it releases every inert subtree
claims.threshold: the same tab-order and scroll-padding assertions as C-29-a

claims.sentence: The spatial family as one surface rather than nine specimens: the shell, a canvas the consumer owns, the chrome the system owns, and the readouts that carry their own provenance
claims.threshold: the family is read from [data-spatial-workspace] in the guide and every block it names must be rendered by at least one template; an empty family fails

claims.sentence: Digits are not quality
claims.threshold: each [data-ladder] row is recomputed from 111.32 km / 10^dp and must agree within 1%; data-precision must equal the decimals printed; a lon-then-lat order badge is required (RFC 7946 §3.1.1, §3.1.10)

claims.sentence: refuses a block that appears in this specimen and in no template
claims.threshold: family discovered from [data-spatial-workspace]; every block must be rendered by at least one of templates/*.html; empty family or empty surface list fails

claims.sentence: the agent-rules artifact cites only gates that exist and run in CI
claims.threshold: the emitter throws at build time, so no artifact with a dangling or unwired enforcement can be written at all — the guard is the backstop for a hand-edited file, not the first line. This clause exists because the row's own premise was false: it called three gates the proof, and reading their assertion loops found one owned no colour literal at all and the other ran in no CI lane while scanning whichever repo it was hard-coded to, not the one it stood in

claims.sentence: the layout reflows to 200 % zoom and to a 390 px viewport with no horizontal page scroll
claims.threshold: scrollWidth <= clientWidth per asserted width, both themes, JS off; a .c-table without .c-table-wrap fails; overflow-x reported so a mask is not read as reflow

claims.sentence: the layout reflows to 200% zoom and to a 390 px viewport with no horizontal
claims.threshold: same lane, run against every shipped page

claims.sentence: 4 external scripts (highlight.js from a CDN, `ds.js`, `wc/index.mjs`, `guide.js`)
claims.threshold: the same re-derivation as README's copy of the sentence, because the gate now walks every document that publishes the figure rather than the one that happened to be right; this sentence replaced a published `20+ external scripts` that no tool ever counted, and the `587 kB` beside it was deleted rather than restamped, since nothing measures the guide's byte size and a hand-copied figure is how the first number went wrong

claims.sentence: 4 external scripts (highlight.js from a CDN, `ds.js`, `wc/index.mjs`, `guide.js`)
claims.threshold: the stated figure, the number of names written beside it and that list's CDN subset are each re-derived from the fetched <script src> set of every shipped page, so the sentence is compared against the pages rather than repeated by the gate; an origin named in the allowlist that no page any longer loads is refused too, because a permission left behind after its dependency is gone approves the next one without anyone choosing it. Falsified 5/5 in a scratch tree, each mutation printing its own byte delta: an uninvited origin in a template, the allowlisted dependency deleted while its allowance stayed, the published figure moved off the measured one, the sentence left naming fewer scripts than it counts, and a CDN claim added to a script the page loads from disk
